elements.name: Platform
elements.description:
Category: Platforms
This is a simple platform.

elements.name: Moving platform
elements.description:
Category: Platforms
This platform moves between 2 different positions.
Set its movement time with the menu and use the swap button to move the ending position

elements.name: Trampoline Platform
elements.description:
Category: Platforms
This platform will send players flying up when they touch it.

elements.name: Bumper
elements.description:
Category: Traps
This trap will send players in the opposite direction when they touch it.

elements.name: Fan
elements.description:
Category: Traps
This trap will push the players away.

elements.name: Thrower
elements.description:
Category: Traps
This trap will shoot projectiles which bump the players away.

elements.name: Checkpoint
elements.description:
Category: Special Platforms
A respawn point for falling players.

elements.name: Start Platform
elements.description:
Category: Special Platforms
The starting point of the race. You must have exactly one.

elements.name: End Platform
elements.description:
Category: Special Platforms
The ending point of the race. You must have exactly one.
